clips.title: The story
paras: Beside the Moonwell of Purity, Shael'dryn watches corruption spread through Ashenvale. East of Iris Lake, she aids night elf scouts and Astranaar's sentinels with relics tainted by demonic and foul influences.

Beside the Moonwell of Purity, Shael'dryn watches the forest's eastern approaches with the night elf sentinels. When corruption touches local wildlife or tainted relics threaten the land's harmony, she draws on her deep understanding of nature to guide adventurers in restoring spiritual balance.
